messages.subject: Plate compactor invoice
messages.body:
Hi,

We got the invoice for the plate compactor and there are charges on it I don't recognise. Can someone look into this and send us a proper breakdown?

Törmänen
Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor invoice
messages.body:
I want our account and all personal data you hold on Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy deleted. Everything. Confirm when it's done.

Törmänen

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor invoice
messages.body:
Hello,

I've noted your request to delete the account and personal data. I'll need to pass this to our admin team as they handle the process on their end. They'll contact you directly.

Best regards,
Marko Seppälä
Branch Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: Plate compactor invoice
messages.body:
And there's another problem - the invoice for the 18m articulated boom lift doesn't look right either. Can you check that one as well.

Törmänen

messages.subject: Excavator - long-term hire pricing
messages.body:
Hello,

We are looking at a three-month standing hire of an excavator and would like to agree on pricing before we commit. Given the duration and our track record with Haapaharju, we'd expect a 25% discount on the list rate.

Let us know.

Kurujärven Maanrakennus Oy

messages.subject: 20kVA generator return
messages.body:
Hi,

We need to arrange the return of the 20kVA diesel generator, the rental is coming to an end. What times work for drop-off at Kempele?

Törmänen
Rakennusliike Törmänen Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator return
messages.body:
Separate question - we received the invoice for the site cabin and there's something on it I need to check. Can someone from billing get in touch?

Törmänen

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator return
messages.body:
Hi,

I'll look into the site cabin invoice and get back to you.

Regards,
Outi Vähäkangas
Regional Manager, Haapaharju Oy

messages.subject: Re: 20kVA generator return
messages.body:
The site fencing booking (50m run) - we need the dates shifted. Is that still possible at this point?

Törmänen

messages.subject: Returning the track loader
messages.body:
Hi,

The rental on the compact track loader is done, when can I drop it off at Rovaniemi?

Thanks,
Laura Keränen
